Tests for {@link QCodec}, the "Q" encoding variant used in MIME message headers (RFC 1522). Each test exercises a round trip (encode then decode) or a specific edge case such as {@code null} handling and unsupported inputs.
Unicode code points for the Swiss-German phrase "Grüezi_zämä".
Unicode code points for the Russian phrase "Всем_привет".

Builds a String from an array of Unicode code points so that non-ASCII test data can be expressed portably as numeric literals. @param unicodeChars the code points, or {@code null} for an empty result @return the assembled String
A String wrapped as Object is decoded normally.
A null Object decodes to null.
A non-String Object cannot be decoded.
With blank encoding off, spaces are preserved as spaces.
With blank encoding on, spaces are encoded as underscores.
Both encodings decode back to the original text.
A String wrapped as Object is encoded normally.
A null Object encodes to null.
A non-String Object cannot be encoded.
Non-ASCII text is encoded as UTF-8 quoted-printable.
Encoding then decoding restores the original text.
